trap-thesis-restatement.notes: SEPARATE FINDING (not a trap, reported not fixed): the closing sentence 'Quantum flatness operates as a derived consequence of the instanton axiom.' appears to reverse the direction the block's own proof establishes. prf:emergence-to-quantum-flat imposes quantum flatness (Step 2: 'Quantum flatness sets B = F_A') and simplicity, and DERIVES the instanton equation F_A^- = 0 from them (Step 3); the second sentence of this very block says the same ('the quantum flatness condition F_A = B, reproducing the instanton equation F_A^- = 0 under simplicity'). Additionally, the term 'instanton axiom' occurs NOWHERE else in content/ (grep: this line is the only hit corpus-wide), so it names no defined axiom. PROPOSED: either delete the sentence, or restate it in the direction the proof supports, e.g. 'The instanton equation is thus a derived consequence of quantum flatness together with the simplicity constraint.'
